note: Standard questions used when the model is unavailable or returns too few. The first question is always 'Tell me about yourself.' (added by code).

opening.question: Tell me about yourself.
opening.why: Almost every interview opens with this. Keep it to about a minute: who you are, your strongest proof for this job, and why this role.

standard.question: Why do you want to work here?
standard.why: They want to see you know the company and chose it on purpose.

standard.question: Why should we hire you for this role?
standard.why: A chance to link your strongest proof to what the job needs.

standard.question: What are your main strengths?
standard.why: Name two, and give a real example from your CV for each.

standard.question: What is one weakness you're working on?
standard.why: They look for honesty and what you're doing about it.

standard.question: Tell us about a time you worked in a team to get something done.
standard.why: Teamwork questions are common at every level.

standard.question: Tell us about a time you made a mistake at work. What did you do?
standard.why: They want to see you own it and learn from it.

standard.question: How do you handle pressure and tight deadlines?
standard.why: Most roles have busy periods; they want a real example.

standard.question: Where do you see yourself in three years?
standard.why: They check that you plan to grow, ideally with them.

standard.question: What do you know about our company?
standard.why: Shows you prepared. Read their website and recent news.

standard.question: Do you have any questions for us?
standard.why: Always have two ready. It shows real interest.
